purpose: Publish the strongest source-controlled attribution to the prosecutor from the 25 July 2023 Calificacion hearing onward while preserving the distinction between Gil Marer's first-hand identification, official institutional attendance and unproved actor-specific knowledge or conduct.

evidence_status.official: Judgment 163/2023 records Ministerio Fiscal attendance at the 25 July 2023 hearing without naming the individual prosecutor.
evidence_status.direct_testimony: Gil Marer directly and positively identifies Ricardo de Mosteyrín Sampalo as physically present throughout the hearing.
evidence_status.open: Official individual identity, exact oral acts, personal receipt and knowledge, adverse act, causation, independent grounds and any separate criminal elements remain to be proved.

attribution_boundary: The post-hearing knowing-instrumentalisation, Article 36.2 retaliation and private-benefit propositions are expressly attributed allegations, not judicial or prosecutorial findings. Presence and procedural capacity do not automatically establish knowledge, causation, intent, concert or criminal liability.
privacy_control: Only public-safe source/status summaries are committed. Native audiovisual files, private correspondence, addresses, message identifiers and custody locators remain outside the public repository.

required: HTML parse, duplicate-ID and internal-link checks
